headline: Police stop NCP leaders' convoy in Sreemangal amid political tension
summary: NCP leaders faced multiple roadblocks while traveling to Habiganj to protest an attack on their convoy, while the district administration imposed Section 144 in the city.
details: NCP leaders reported being blocked multiple times on Wednesday while traveling to Habiganj. The tension follows a previous attack on the party's central leaders' convoy on Tuesday evening.
The leaders departed from the Moulvibazar Circuit House after 4 PM. They were first stopped by police in the tea-kanya area of Sreemangal, where they remained held for approximately 30 minutes.

Around 5:05 PM, the convoy managed to cross the police blockade and continued toward Habiganj, but they encountered further obstacles in the same area. At one point, NCP leaders sat on the road in protest.

The Habiganj district administration imposed Section 144 in the municipal area to prevent potential law and order deterioration. This decision came as both NCP and BNP had scheduled programs in the city simultaneously.

headline: Former minister Abdul Latif Siddiqui arrested in Shapla Chattar case
summary: The Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Branch (DB) arrested the former minister from his residence in Gulshan on Wednesday.
details: Former minister Abdul Latif Siddiqui has been arrested in connection with a case regarding the killings at Motijheel's Shapla Chattar in the capital.
The Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Branch (DB) carried out the arrest on Wednesday, July 29.
Additional Commissioner Shafiqul Islam of the DB confirmed the arrest, stating that Siddiqui was apprehended from his own residence in Gulshan.
According to the Additional Commissioner, the arrest was made based on a warrant for crimes against humanity.
